_note: Free, external learning resources shown on the Learn screen. 'section' matches config.json section ids (aptitude, reasoning, coding, communication, domain) or 'core-cs'/'company'/'interview' for cross-cutting prep. Every entry is free to use and hosted outside PlaceIQ - PlaceIQ only links out, it never proxies or copies the material. Add your own rows here; they are seeded into the resource table and validated by the admin import screen.

resources.title: IndiaBix - Aptitude question bank (topic-wise)
resources.blurb: The standard campus-placement grind: percentages, ratios, averages, time-speed-distance, profit-loss. Unlimited questions with worked solutions - start with the topic you scored lowest on.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks - Aptitude for Placements
resources.blurb: Formula-first revision notes for every aptitude topic tested by TCS, Infosys, Wipro and Cognizant, with shortcuts for the 60-second-per-question format.

resources.title: Khan Academy - Arithmetic and pre-algebra
resources.blurb: If the basics feel shaky, this is the gentlest rebuild: short videos plus instant-feedback drills, fully free and no sign-up needed.

resources.title: PrepInsta - Company-wise aptitude papers
resources.blurb: Pattern-accurate previous-year papers for the exact companies in your target list. Use it once your accuracy is above 70% to train on real paper timing.

resources.title: IndiaBix - Logical reasoning and verbal ability
resources.blurb: Series, coding-decoding, syllogisms, blood relations, seating arrangement - the reasoning half of every written round.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks - Puzzles asked in interviews
resources.blurb: The classic puzzle bank (jug problems, weighing, river crossing, seating). Read the solution only after a real attempt - interviewers care about the reasoning, not the answer.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks - Data interpretation practice
resources.blurb: Charts, tables and caselets: the section that quietly decides cut-offs in TCS NQT and Infosys papers.

resources.title: Striver A2Z DSA sheet (takeUforward)
resources.blurb: The most used free DSA roadmap among Indian students: ~450 problems ordered so each one teaches the next pattern. Cover it slowly rather than skimming.

resources.title: NeetCode - DSA roadmap with free video solutions
resources.blurb: Pattern-based ordering (arrays, hashing, two pointers, sliding window, trees, DP) with a free video explanation per problem. Best partner for the DP gap most students hit.

resources.title: LeetCode - Top Interview 150 study plan
resources.blurb: 150 curated questions that cover the interview syllabus. Timed practice with the built-in editor - aim for medium problems under 25 minutes.

resources.title: HackerRank - Algorithms and data structures track
resources.blurb: Good for cleaning up input-output handling and edge cases, which is where most campus coding rounds are actually lost.

resources.title: freeCodeCamp - DSA full course (free video)
resources.blurb: A single long-form video covering structures and complexity with worked code. Useful when you want one continuous pass instead of scattered topic hopping.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks - DBMS revision track (SQL, normalisation, indexing)
resources.blurb: The revision layer for technical interviews: normalisation, indexing, transactions, deadlocks. Pair it with the OS and Networks tracks on the same site the week before the interview.

resources.title: Harvard CS50x - Introduction to Computer Science
resources.blurb: Free, rigorous and project-driven. If you have time for one long course before placements, this is the one that changes how you think about code.

resources.title: OSTEP - free Operating Systems textbook
resources.blurb: A free, well-written OS book (PDF chapters). Use the scheduling and virtual-memory chapters to answer interview follow-ups with real depth.

resources.title: Coursera - Improving Communication Skills (Wharton)
resources.blurb: Free to audit. Directly targets the interview skills scored in this app: structuring an answer, listening, and speaking without filler.

resources.title: Tech Interview Handbook - STAR behavioural answers
resources.blurb: How to build 'tell me about yourself' and conflict stories with the Situation-Task-Action-Result structure, including ready-to-adapt examples.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks - Group discussion and HR round guide
resources.blurb: GD ground rules for Indian campus placements: entering the discussion, building on others, and the closing summary that gets you noticed.

resources.title: NPTEL - free certified courses in every engineering domain
resources.blurb: IIT/IISc courses with free video lectures and a paid-optional certificate. Search your own branch (ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil, IT) to refresh the domain questions in your company's technical round.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks - Operating Systems interview track
resources.blurb: Processes, scheduling, deadlock, paging and memory management - the follow-ups that decide technical rounds for IT-services roles.

resources.title: Tech Interview Handbook - the complete free guide
resources.blurb: End-to-end: resume, behavioural rounds, coding strategies, negotiation. Free and actively maintained - read the resume and offer chapters even if you skip the rest.

resources.title: InterviewBit - structured interview practice
resources.blurb: Topic-wise interview questions with a time-boxed practice mode and company tags, useful after your first diagnostic.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks - interview experiences, newest first
resources.blurb: Round-by-round accounts from candidates who sat the same papers. Filter to your target company and read the last six months before the drive.

resources.title: Naukri Campus - off-campus drives and hiring challenges
resources.blurb: Live openings, off-campus drives and practice challenges from Indian employers. Worth a weekly check once your readiness is Intermediate or above.

resources.title: IndiaBix - timed online aptitude test (dress rehearsal)
resources.blurb: Timed mock in the browser, 16 questions, no pausing, score at the end. Sit it in one sitting to rehearse exam-day pressure.

resources.title: IndiaBix - online timed logical reasoning test
resources.blurb: Reasoning section under exam timing, scored immediately. Compare the result with your PlaceIQ reasoning accuracy.

resources.title: HackerRank - Interview Preparation Kit
resources.blurb: A guided 20-hour warm-up: warm-ups, arrays, dictionaries, sorting, strings, greedy and search, with a video walkthrough per section.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks - interview preparation hub (subject-wise)
resources.blurb: One page that links every subject track: DSA, DBMS, OS, networks, OOP and system design basics, ordered by how often each is asked.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks - Top 100 DSA interview questions (topic-wise)
resources.blurb: A short list to triage with: work top-to-bottom and you have covered the patterns that actually appear in campus coding rounds.
